Dependency state

Manual reorder is disabled while search or filters hide cards, or while a column uses a non-manual sort.

Project dependencies

Whole-project view, including isolated tasks. Shared search and filters apply in both views; direct prerequisites outside the matches are labelled as dependency context.

Arrows run from prerequisite to dependent: A → B means B depends on A. Click to inspect, double-click to edit, or Shift+double-click to focus a node's neighbourhood. Drag to pan, Shift+drag to zoom to a box, and Shift+wheel to zoom. Right-click a node or press Shift+F10/Menu for node actions. Use arrow keys or Home/End to navigate nodes; in the menu, use arrows, Enter, or Escape.

Solid arrows: dependencies. Stronger arrows: current blockers. Purple outlines: longest unweighted dependency chain. Dashed nodes/arrows: unresolved references. Cycle warnings identify tasks, not every edge in a cycle.

Workflow intelligence

These are project-wide measures, independent of active filters. Dependency readiness is advisory only; it is not a status, claim, or authorization to execute.

Longest dependency chain (unweighted)

Cycle tasks are excluded. This structural chain is not a schedule critical path because task durations are not configured.

Accessible task and relationship list

Every task and unresolved reference is listed with its direct relationships. Select a title to inspect it in the diagram.
